<td style="width: 140px"> </td>
<td style="width: 510px; vertical-align: text-top;">
<table style="margin: 0px; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;"> <tbody> <tr> <td><img src="https://www.ta-retirement.com/resources/ttl-trs-recentnews.gif"/></td></tr><!-- Content Starts Here --> <tr> <td align="left" valign="top"><p><b><u></u></b></p><h2><div style="font-weight: bold; text-align: center;"><b><u><span><font color="#ff0090">ATTENTION RETIREMENT PLAN PARTICIPANTS:</font></span></u></b><br/><br/></div><u><div style="text-align: center;"><b><u><span><font color="#ff0090">TO ACCESS YOUR ACCOUNT PLEASE CLICK </font></span></u></b><u><b><a href="https://www.transamerica.com/register-account/" target="_blank">HERE</a></b></u></div></u></h2><p style="font-weight: bold;"></p><p><span><b>PLEASE READ THE MESSAGE BELOW REGARDING YOUR ONLINE ACCOUNT ACCESS.</b></span><br/></p><div style="text-align: center;"><u><b>NOTICE FOR ALL RETIREMENT PLAN PARTICIPANTS:</b></u></div><p></p><div style="font-weight: bold; text-align: center;"><b></b></div><p></p><p><span>On December 2<sup>nd</sup>, 2018, Transamerica implemented increased website security features on all accounts. As a result, our website has moved to <a href="https://www.transamerica.com">www.Transamerica.com</a></span></p><span><b>What do I need to do? <br/>To access your account, all users will need to update their online profile by clicking </b></span><b><a href="https://www.transamerica.com/register-account/" target="_blank">HERE</a>, then selecting Retirement Plans to begin profile registration.</b><br/><br/>During this process, you will be asked to verify and update your personal information and other account details. Once you have completed the registration process, you can visit <a href="https://www.transamerica.com" target="_blank">transamerica.com</a> to access your account.<p></p><p !important;"="" display:="" inline=""></p><br/><div style="text-align: center;"><b><u><span>NOTICE TO ALL RETIREMENT PLAN SPONSORS &amp; THIRD PARTY ADMINISTRATORS</span></u></b></div><p></p><div style="text-align: center;"><b></b></div><div style="text-align: center;"><b></b></div><div style="text-align: center;"><b></b></div><div style="font-weight: bold; text-align: center;"><b></b></div><p><span>The same increased security features will be implemented for you within the next several weeks.<br/><br/>For now, you will continue to log in to <a href="https://www.ta-retirement.com" style="" target="_blank">ta-retirement.com</a> as normal. <br/><br/>Please stay tuned to this website for further communication.</span></p><p><br/></p><p></p><table style="font-weight: bold; margin: 0px; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;"> <tbody></tbody></table><b> </b><p><font face="sans-serif"><span></span></font><font face="sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><br/></span></font></p></td></tr></tbody></table><br/><br/><p></p>
</td>
</tr>
